notes.title: Demo Beta Build v0.1.2
notes.content:
[p]Known Bugs/Issues.

Grinding on the circular rails you will fly off early because it will detect you got to the end of the rail.

No animations for tricks at the moment.

Sometimes when you are in the air and press the trick button your current score will not be shown.

Sometimes when you land you will slowly sink back down instead of already being at ground level

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627932/db5c694b2fcf801c343abe2f50357a15695ae91f.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Beta Build v0.1.1
notes.content: [p]In this version I have added jumping which you can do by pressing Space on the Keyboard or the South Button on a gamepad, Tricking you do while in the air and by pressing E on keyboard or West Button on a gamepad.[/p]
